product: The semaglutide GLP-1 franchise creates the demand: Wegovy for obesity including the oral Wegovy pill and Wegovy HD 7.2mg, Ozempic for diabetes, plus CagriSema. EMA approved the Wegovy pill and the 7.2mg pen in July 2026, and the pill drove US volume (novonordisk.com 2026-08-04; 2026-09-07 STEP Young data).
demand: Volume-led. Q2 2026 adjusted sales rose 7% CER on GLP-1 volume growth across geographies plus favourable one-off US rebate adjustments, while reported sales grew only 3% CER after a 340B rebate provision reversal (novonordisk.com company announcement 2026-08-04).
pricing_power: US net-price and rebate pressure: the Q2 2026 lift came partly from one-off favourable rebate adjustments, offset by a 340B reversal, with operating profit down 16% CER (2026-08-04). DKK 6.3bn impairments including monlunabant DKK 4.0bn (2026-08-04). Patent expiry and a cleared Wegovy generic (Mylan 2026-09-25) would compress margins.
competition: Compounded semaglutide is the near substitute and Novo is litigating it (Dutch injunction 2026-08-05). Mylan asked a US court to clear a Wegovy generic from Novo patents (Reuters 2026-09-25). Dated Chinese biosimilar semaglutide progress: not found in the sources read.
market_strategy: CEO Mike Doustdar, 2026-08-04: 'The Wegovy product portfolio remains a key growth driver for Novo Nordisk in 2026', and raised FY26 adjusted sales and operating profit guidance to 0% to -6% CER. At Capital Markets Day on 2026-09-21 he targeted above 23bn USD of pipeline sales by 2035 with five multiblockbuster drugs.
bull: Q2 2026 adjusted sales +7% CER, operating profit +11% CER, FY26 guidance raised (2026-08-04); CagriSema beat tirzepatide in REIMAGINE 5 (2026-09-21); Wegovy pill above 265k weekly US scripts.
bear: Operating profit -16% CER on 340B reversal and DKK 6.3bn impairments; ZEUS failed (2026-07-31); stock fell 8% on Capital Markets Day; Morgan Stanley Underweight, Berenberg and Goldman cuts; Mylan Wegovy patent challenge.
falsifier: Q3 2026 results on 2026-11-04 showing adjusted sales growth outside the 0% to -6% CER guidance, or US weekly Wegovy pill prescriptions below the ~265k baseline of 2026-08-04.

web_bottleneck: The company bottleneck is investor trust and pipeline depth ahead of patent expiry, not factory capacity: the CEO flagged M&A and pipeline gaps (Reuters 2026-09-23; CNBC 2026-09-24). Novo relieves the obesity and diabetes treatment-access bottleneck via oral and longer-acting GLP-1s (novonordisk.com 2026-08-04; 2026-09-25).
web_who_benefits_next: Nanexa, the drug-delivery partner, jumped about 122% on the 2026-09-25 deal. AI partners Anthropic (2026-09-16) and AWS (2026-08-10). Peptide CDMOs and injectable-device makers scaling GLP-1 supply, plus pharmacies and telehealth channels dispensing the Wegovy pill.
web_who_loses: Eli Lilly competes and gains GLP-1 ground, though it won FDA approval for once-weekly insulin Onswik (Fierce Pharma 2026-09-25). Compounded semaglutide sellers lose: Novo won a Dutch injunction (2026-08-05). Generic challengers like Mylan seek to clear Wegovy patents (Reuters 2026-09-25). Other obesity biotechs face a higher bar.

web_did_they_deliver: Partly. On 2026-08-04 Q2 adjusted sales +7% and operating profit +11% CER and FY26 guidance raised from -4% to -12% into 0% to -6% CER: delivered. Wegovy pill launched in UAE June and UK July 2026 with over 5m US prescriptions: delivered (2026-08-04). Missed: ziltivekimab ZEUS phase 3 failed its primary endpoint (2026-07-31).

US weekly Wegovy pill prescriptions falling below the about 265k baseline of 2026-08-04. A US court clearing a Wegovy generic in the Mylan case (2026-09-25), another pipeline failure or impairment, or further downgrades.
